title: Green Hornet
description: Whiskey, vodka, gin, and green creme de menthe are mixed together creating a strong drink called "Green Hornet". Drink slowly!
ingredients: 0.75 fluid ounce green creme de menthe
0.5 fluid ounce cola-flavored carbonated beverage (such as Coca-Cola®), or more to taste
0.5 fluid ounce lemon-lime carbonated beverage (such as 7Up®), or to taste
0.5 fluid ounce sweet and sour mix, or to taste
1 cup crushed ice, or as desired

steps.text: Mix whiskey, vodka, gin, creme de menthe, cola-flavored beverage, lemon-lime flavored beverage, and sweet and sour mix together in a cocktail shake. Fill a glass with ice; pour drink over ice.
